texts.preamble: Guwahati Police Station In The District ... vs The State Of Assam on 29 November, 2024 Page No.# 1/3 Gahc010251812024 undefined The Gauhati High Court (High Court Of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram And Arunachal Pradesh) I.A.(Crl.)/1161/2024 Pranab Bhatta S/O Late Sushil Bhatta R/O Kalapahar Guwahati Police Station In The District Of Kamrup (M) Assam Versus The State Of Assam Rep. By The Pp Govt. Of Assam ------------ Advocate for : Mr. B M Choudhury Advocate for : Pp Assam appearing for The State Of Assam Before Honourable Mrs. Justice Mitali Thakuria Order
texts.arguments: Mr. Choudhury further submitted that the petitioner was on bail during the entire period of trial he never jumped over any conditions of bail and accordingly prayed to allow the petitioner to remain on previous bail and further prayed for suspension of execution of sentence passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge No. 5, Kamrup (M) in Criminal Appeal No. 04/2021 dated 24.09.2024. 5.
